name: Starting A Business
overview: Starting a business, as reflected in Scripture, is an endeavor that must be grounded in dependence on the Lord, recognizing that it is God who grants the ability to gain wealth and establish success. The believer is called to commit their plans and works to the Lord, trusting that He will order their steps and establish their thoughts. Without the Lord’s guidance and blessing, efforts are ultimately in vain, emphasizing the necessity of mercy, truth, and faithfulness as foundational principles in all undertakings.
